sourceFacts: Parallel ray enters a small-apex prism normally at first face.
Second face partially transmits and internally reflects.
Back-returning ray exits first face at 4 degrees to reversed incident direction.
Find prism index and prism apex angle.
missing: Explicit exterior refractive index if an absolute prism index is desired.
Finite prism dimensions and path reach, source power/width, detector, material Fresnel branch policy.
source.note: This is a development-time source-bound conditional interpretation, not an independently scored JEE solution.

derivation.notation: m=n_inside/n_outside; A=positive apex angle; T>0 transmitted deviation in forward direction; R>0 return deviation with respect to reversed incident beam.
notes: Both first-order relationships are conditional on face 1 normal incidence and face 2 transmitted/reflected rays returning to face 1.
The exact trig witness is ONLY a first-order-suitability guard; not native propagation, validated Fresnel power or a true exact inverse.
Physical prism reach, returned ray incidence at face 1, polarization, Fresnel powers, weak native branch truncation are not supplied by scalar model.
